items.1: Praise is to Allah Who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and unto Him is the resurrection.
items.2: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the greatest, and there is no power and no might except with Allah, the Most High, the Mighty. My Lord, forgive me.
items.3: Praise be to Allah who restored health to my body, returned my soul to me and allowed me to remember Him.
items.4: Recite verses 190 to 200 of Surat Al ʿImran (Quran 3:190-200).
items.5: Praise is to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me with no power or strength from myself.
items.6: O Allah, to You belongs all praise: You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
items.7: May you wear it out, and may Allah, the Most High, replace it for you.
items.8: Wear something new, live praiseworthy and die a martyr.
items.10: [In the name of Allah.] O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.
items.13: I bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.
items.14: O Allah, make me one of those who repent often and make me one of those who purify themselves.
items.15: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but You; I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance.
items.16: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
items.17: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, from slipping or being made to slip, from wronging others or being wronged, and from acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.
items.18: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and in Allah, our Lord, we place our trust. Then greet one’s family.
items.19: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light beneath me, light on my right, light on my left, light before me and light behind me; place light in my soul, increase light for me, make light great for me, grant me light and make me a light. O Allah, give me light, place light in my sinews, in my flesh, in my blood, in my hair and in my skin. [O Allah, place light for me in my grave… and light in my bones.] [Increase me in light, increase me in light, increase me in light.] [And grant me light upon light.]
items.20: (Starting with the right foot.) I seek refuge with Allah the Mighty, with His noble Face and His eternal authority, from Satan the accursed. [In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah.] O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
items.21: (Starting with the left foot.) In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from Satan the accursed.
items.22: Repeat what the muezzin says, except at “Hayya ʿala s-salah” (come to prayer) and “Hayya ʿala l-falah” (come to success), where one says: “There is no power and no might except with Allah.”
items.23: After the muezzin’s declaration of faith, say: “And I too bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as messenger and with Islam as religion.”
items.24: After answering the muezzin, send blessings upon the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him).
items.25: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the eminent station (al-wasila) and the distinction (al-fadila), and raise him to the praised station You have promised him. [You never fail in Your promise.]
items.26: Make supplication for oneself between the adhan and the iqama: supplication at that time is not rejected.
items.27: O Allah, put distance between me and my sins as You have put distance between the East and the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash away my sins with snow, water and hail.
items.28: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.
items.29: I have turned my face, as a sincere believer, to Him who created the heavens and the earth, and I am not one of the polytheists. My prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death belong to Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner: this is what I was commanded, and I am one of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King: there is no god worthy of worship but You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant; I have wronged myself and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me all my sins, for none forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of character, for none guides to it but You, and turn away from me the worst of it, for none turns it away but You. Here I am at Your service, and all good is in Your hands; evil is not attributed to You. I am by You and I return to You. You are blessed and exalted; I ask Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance.
items.30: O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mika’il and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants in what they used to differ about. Guide me, by Your permission, to the truth in what has been disputed, for You guide whom You will to a straight path.
items.31: Allah is the greatest, greatly so (three times). Praise be to Allah, abundant praise (three times). Glory be to Allah morning and evening (three times). I seek refuge with Allah from Satan: from his breath (arrogance), his spitting (poetry) and his whisper (madness).
items.32: O Allah, to You belongs all praise: You are the light of the heavens and the earth and all who are in them. To You belongs all praise: You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all who are in them. [To You belongs all praise: You are the Lord of the heavens, the earth and all who are in them.] [To You belongs all praise: Yours is the dominion of the heavens, the earth and all who are in them.] [To You belongs all praise: You are the King of the heavens and the earth.] [To You belongs all praise.] [You are the Truth, Your promise is true, Your word is true, meeting You is true, Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the prophets are true, Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) is true and the Hour is true.] [O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have placed my trust, in You I have believed, to You I turn, by You I argue and to You I bring my judgment. Forgive me what I have sent ahead and what I have left behind, what I have hidden and what I have declared.] [And what You know better than I.] [You are the One who brings forward and the One who puts back; there is no god worthy of worship but You.] [You are my God; there is no god worthy of worship but You.] [And there is no power and no might except with Allah.]
items.33: Glory be to my Lord, the Mighty. (Three times.)
items.34: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
items.35: Most Perfect, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and of the Spirit (Jibril).
items.36: O Allah, for You I have bowed, in You I have believed and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my marrow, my bones and my sinews [and what my feet carry] are humbled before You.
items.37: Glory be to the Possessor of all power, sovereignty, greatness and majesty.
items.38: Allah hears the one who praises Him.
items.39: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise, abundant, good and blessed praise.
items.40: As much as fills the heavens, the earth and all that is between them, and as much as You will beyond that. You are worthy of praise and glory; it is the truest thing a servant can say, and we are all Your servants. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of the one who has it does not avail him against You.
items.41: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High. (Three times.)
items.42: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
items.43: Most Perfect, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and of the Spirit (Jibril).
items.44: O Allah, for You I have prostrated, in You I have believed and to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before the One who created it, shaped it and opened its hearing and its sight. Blessed be Allah, the best of creators.
items.45: Glory be to the Possessor of all power, sovereignty, greatness and majesty.
items.46: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the hidden.
items.47: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count Your praises: You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.48: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.
items.49: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, set my condition right, grant me well-being, provide for me and raise my rank.
items.50: My face has prostrated before the One who created it and opened its hearing and its sight by His might and His power. Blessed be Allah, the best of creators.
items.51: O Allah, record for me a reward with You for this prostration, relieve me by it of a burden, keep it for me as a treasure with You and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant Dawud.
items.52: All greetings, prayers and good words belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.
items.53: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are worthy of praise and glory. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are worthy of praise and glory.
items.54: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad, his wives and his descendants as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim, and bless Muhammad, his wives and his descendants as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; You are worthy of praise and glory.
items.55: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trial of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (al-Masih ad-Dajjal).
items.56: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of the False Messiah and from the trial of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and debt.
items.57: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins but You. Grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.58: O Allah, forgive me what I have sent ahead and what I have left behind, what I have hidden and what I have declared, my excesses and what You know better than I. You are the One who brings forward and the One who puts back; there is no god worthy of worship but You.
items.59: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You and to worship You well.
items.60: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, from cowardice, from being brought back to the worst stage of life, from the trial of this world and from the punishment of the grave.
items.61: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.62: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life to be better for me, and take me when You know death to be better for me. O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in the unseen and in the seen; I ask You for the word of truth in contentment and in anger; I ask You for moderation in wealth and in poverty; I ask You for bliss that does not run out and a delight of the eyes that does not cease; I ask You for contentment after the decree; I ask You for a cool, easy life after death; I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and the longing to meet You, without harmful hardship or misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the adornment of faith and make us guides who are rightly guided.
items.63: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by the fact that You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor is begotten and to whom none is equal, to forgive me my sins; You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.64: O Allah, I ask You by the fact that all praise belongs to You; there is no god worthy of worship but You, alone, without partner, the Bestower of favours, O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Lord of majesty and generosity, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining: I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.65: O Allah, I ask You, bearing witness that You are Allah — there is no god worthy of worship but You — the One, the Eternal Refuge, who neither begets nor is begotten and to whom none is equal.
items.66: I ask Allah for forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Lord of majesty and generosity.
items.67: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things [three times]. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of the one who has it does not avail him against You.
items.68: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no power and no might except with Allah; there is no god worthy of worship but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the favour, His is the grace and His is the beautiful praise. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, to whom we devote our religion sincerely, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
items.69: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is the greatest (thirty-three times). There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
items.70: Recite the last three chapters of the Quran, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, each preceded by the basmala, after every prayer.
items.71: Recite Ayat al-Kursi, the Throne Verse (Quran 2:255), after every prayer.
items.72: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things. (Ten times, after the maghrib and the fajr prayers.)
items.73: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds. (After the salam of the fajr prayer.)
items.74: Jabir ibn ʿAbdillah (may Allah be pleased with them) said: the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) used to teach us istikhara in all matters, just as he taught us a chapter of the Quran. He would say: “If one of you is considering a matter, let him pray two voluntary units of prayer, then say: ‘O Allah, I ask You to guide me by Your knowledge, I ask You for ability by Your power and I ask You of Your great bounty. For You are able and I am not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter (he names his need) is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affair (or: in the near and the distant future), then decree it for me, make it easy for me and then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affair (or: in the near and the distant future), then turn it away from me, turn me away from it and decree for me the good wherever it may be, then make me content with it.’” One who consults the Creator, takes counsel from the believers and stays firm in his decision will not regret it: Allah the Most High has said: “Consult them in the matter; then, when you have decided, put your trust in Allah.”
items.75: Seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed, then recite Ayat al-Kursi, the Throne Verse (Quran 2:255).
items.76: Recite the last three chapters of the Quran, Al-Ikhlas (112), Al-Falaq (113) and An-Nas (114), each preceded by the basmala. Three times.
items.77: We have reached the morning and sovereignty belongs to Allah; praise be to Allah. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from a punishment in the Fire and a punishment in the grave. [In the evening say: “We have reached the evening and sovereignty belongs to Allah…”, then: “My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.”]
items.78: O Allah, by You we reach the morning and by You we reach the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection. [In the evening: “O Allah, by You we reach the evening and by You we reach the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.”]
items.79: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your slave, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I confess my sin. Forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.80: O Allah, this morning I call You to witness, and I call to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no god worthy of worship but You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger. (Four times.) [In the evening say: “O Allah, this evening I call You to witness…”]
items.81: O Allah, every blessing that has come to me this morning, or to any of Your creation, is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise and to You all thanks. [In the evening: “O Allah, every blessing that has come to me this evening…”]
items.82: O Allah, grant health to my body. O Allah, grant health to my hearing. O Allah, grant health to my sight. There is no god worthy of worship but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god worthy of worship but You. (Three times.)
items.83: Allah is enough for me. There is no god worthy of worship but Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne. (Seven times.)
items.84: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and in the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me and from behind me, from my right and from my left, and from above me; and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being swallowed up from beneath me.
items.85: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, from the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and from doing wrong to myself or bringing it upon another Muslim.
items.86: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm; He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Three times.)
items.87: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) as my prophet. (Three times.)
items.88: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, I seek Your help through Your mercy: set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself, not even for the blink of an eye.
items.89: We have reached the morning and sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its victory, its help, its light, its blessing and its guidance; and I seek refuge in You from the evil it holds and the evil that follows it. [In the evening: “We have reached the evening and sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its victory, its help, its light, its blessing and its guidance; and I seek refuge in You from the evil it holds and the evil that follows it.”]
items.90: We have reached the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submissive, who was not one of the polytheists. [In the evening: “We have reached the evening upon the natural religion of Islam…”]
items.91: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. (One hundred times.)
items.92: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. (Ten times, or once if feeling lazy.)
items.93: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. (One hundred times, in the morning.)
items.94: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him: as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne and as much as the ink of His words. (Three times, in the morning.)
items.95: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds. (In the morning.)
items.96: I seek Allah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance. (One hundred times a day.)
items.97: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (Three times, in the evening.)
items.98: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad. (Ten times.)
items.99: Join both palms, breathe lightly into them and recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, then wipe the hands over as much of the body as possible, beginning with the head, the face and the front of the body. Do this three times.
items.100: Recite Ayat al-Kursi, the Throne Verse (Quran 2:255).
items.101: Recite the last two verses of Surat Al-Baqara (Quran 2:285-286).
items.102: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise. If You take my soul, have mercy upon it, and if You return it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
items.103: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it back; to You belong its death and its life. If You keep it alive, protect it; and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
items.104: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.
items.105: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
items.106: Glory be to Allah (thirty-three times), praise be to Allah (thirty-three times), Allah is the greatest (thirty-four times).
items.107: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion (the Quran): I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything You hold by the forelock. O Allah, You are the First: nothing is before You; You are the Last: nothing is after You; You are the Manifest: nothing is above You; You are the Hidden: nothing is beneath You. Settle our debts for us and spare us from poverty.
items.108: Praise be to Allah, who fed us and gave us drink, who sufficed us and sheltered us; how many have no one to suffice them or shelter them!
items.109: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, from the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and from doing wrong to myself or bringing it upon another Muslim.
items.110: Recite Surat As-Sajda (32, which begins with Alif Lam Mim) and Surat Al-Mulk (67).
items.111: O Allah, I submit my soul to You, I entrust my affair to You, I turn my face to You and I lean my back on You, in hope and in fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
items.112: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, the One, the Irresistible, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Great Forgiver.
items.113: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, from the whisperings of the devils and from their presence near me.
items.114: Spit lightly to one’s left (three times), seek refuge with Allah from Satan and from the evil of what one saw (three times), tell no one about it, and turn over to the other side from the one on which one was sleeping.
items.115: Get up and pray, if one wishes.
items.116: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given and protect me from the evil You have decreed; for You decree and none decrees against You. The one You take as ally is never humiliated [and the one You take as enemy is never mighty]. Blessed are You, our Lord, and exalted.
items.117: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count Your praises: You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.118: O Allah, You alone we worship, for You we pray and prostrate, toward You we hasten and strive. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment; Your punishment will surely reach the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, we praise You with good and do not deny You; we believe in You, we submit to You and we disown whoever denies You.
items.119: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy (three times), raising and lengthening the voice on the third: “Lord of the angels and of the Spirit.”
items.120: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; my forelock is in Your hand, Your judgment over me is carried out and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the removal of my sorrow and the release of my worry.
items.121: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.
items.122: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the noble Throne.
items.123: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for: do not leave me to myself, not even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no god worthy of worship but You.
items.124: There is no god worthy of worship but You; glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers.
items.125: Allah, Allah is my Lord: I associate nothing with Him.
items.126: O Allah, we place You before them and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
items.127: O Allah, You are my support and my helper; by You I move, by You I attack and by You I fight.
items.128: Allah is enough for us, and what an excellent Guardian!
items.129: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and of the mighty Throne, be a protector for me against so-and-so, son of so-and-so, and his supporters among Your creatures, so that none of them may wrong me or transgress against me. Mighty is the one You protect, glorious is Your praise, and there is no god worthy of worship but You.
items.130: Allah is the greatest. Allah is mightier than all His creation. Allah is mightier than what I fear and guard against. I seek refuge in Allah, besides whom there is no god, who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His permission, from the evil of Your servant so-and-so, his soldiers, his followers and his supporters, among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be a protector for me against their evil; glorious is Your praise, mighty is the one You protect, blessed is Your name, and there is no god but You. (Three times.)
items.131: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
items.132: O Allah, suffice me against them in whatever way You will.
items.133: Seek refuge with Allah and stop dwelling on what one doubts.
items.134: Say: “I believe in Allah and His messengers.”
items.136: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have forbidden, and enrich me by Your grace so that I need no one but You.
items.137: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.
items.138: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed; then spit lightly to one’s left (three times).
items.139: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You have made easy, and You make the difficult easy whenever You wish.
items.140: Any servant who commits a sin, then performs ablution well, stands and prays two units of prayer and asks Allah for forgiveness, Allah forgives him.
items.141: Seek refuge with Allah from him.
items.143: The adhkar and the recitation of the Quran.
items.144: Allah has decreed it, and He has done what He willed.
items.145: May Allah bless you in what He has given you, may you thank the Giver, may the child reach maturity and may you be granted its kindness. The one who is congratulated replies: May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, may Allah reward you with good, grant you the like and multiply your reward.
items.146: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) used to place Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (may Allah be pleased with them) under Allah’s protection, saying: “I place you both under the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, every harmful creature and every evil eye.”
items.147: No harm: may it be a purification, if Allah wills.
items.148: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the mighty Throne, to heal you. (Seven times.)
items.149: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “When a man visits his Muslim brother, he walks gathering the fruits of Paradise until he sits; once he sits, mercy covers him. If it is morning, seventy thousand angels pray for him until evening; if it is evening, seventy thousand angels pray for him until morning.”
items.150: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me and join me with the highest companions.
items.151: As his death approached, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) would dip his hands in water, wipe his face with them and say: “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah; death has its agonies indeed.”
items.152: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah; His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, and there is no power and no might except with Allah.
items.153: Whoever’s last words are “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah” will enter Paradise.
items.154: To Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
items.155: O Allah, forgive so-and-so (mention his name), raise his rank among the rightly guided, take his place with those he leaves behind, and forgive us and him, Lord of the worlds. Make his grave spacious and give it light for him.
items.156: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him, honour his place of arrival, widen his entrance, wash him with water, snow and hail, cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt, give him in exchange a home better than his home, a family better than his family and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and the punishment of the Fire].
items.157: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our men and our women. O Allah, whoever among us You keep alive, keep him alive upon Islam, and whoever among us You take, take him upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not lead us astray after him.
items.158: O Allah, so-and-so, son of so-and-so, is under Your protection and Your safeguard: shield him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. You are the One who keeps His word, and You are the Truth. Forgive him and have mercy on him; You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.159: O Allah, Your servant, the son of Your maidservant, is in need of Your mercy, and You have no need to punish him. If he did good, increase his good deeds; if he did wrong, overlook his faults.
items.160: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave. [It is also good to say:] O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, an intercessor whose plea is answered. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him, increase their reward through him, join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell, give him in exchange a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who went before us, our children who died before us and those who preceded us in faith.
items.161: O Allah, make him for us a forerunner, a predecessor and a reward.
items.162: To Allah belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term… Be patient and hope for Allah’s reward. One may also say: May Allah increase your reward, grant you a beautiful consolation and forgive your deceased.
items.163: In the name of Allah and according to the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
items.164: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, make him steadfast.
items.165: Peace be upon you, people of these abodes, believers and Muslims. We shall join you, if Allah wills. [May Allah have mercy on those of us who went ahead and those who will come after.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
items.166: O Allah, I ask You for its good and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
items.167: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good it contains and the good it was sent with; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil it contains and the evil it was sent with.
items.168: Glory is to Him whom thunder exalts with praise and the angels as well from fear of Him.
items.169: O Allah, send us rain that relieves, nourishes and makes the land fertile, beneficial and not harmful, now and not later.
items.170: O Allah, relieve us. O Allah, relieve us. O Allah, relieve us.
items.171: O Allah, give water to Your servants and Your livestock, spread Your mercy and give life to Your dead land.
items.172: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain.
items.173: Rain has fallen upon us by the grace of Allah and His mercy.
items.174: O Allah, around us and not upon us. O Allah, upon the hills, the heights, the valley floors and the places where trees grow.
items.175: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, bring this moon over us with security and faith, with peace and Islam, and with success in what You love and are pleased with, our Lord. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
items.176: The thirst has gone, the veins are moist, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
items.177: O Allah, I ask You, by Your mercy which encompasses all things, to forgive me.
items.178: When one of you eats, let him say: “In the name of Allah.” If he forgets to say it at the beginning, let him say: “In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.”
items.179: Whoever Allah feeds, let him say: “O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.” Whoever Allah gives milk to drink, let him say: “O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.”
items.180: Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part.
items.181: Praise be to Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise, praise that is never ended, never bid farewell and never dispensed with, our Lord.
items.182: O Allah, bless what You have provided for them, forgive them and have mercy on them.
items.183: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
items.184: May those who fast break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food and may the angels pray for you.
items.185: If one of you is invited, let him accept; if he is fasting, let him pray (that is, supplicate for those present), and if he is not fasting, let him eat.
items.186: I am fasting, I am fasting.
items.187: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our city for us, bless our sa‘ for us and bless our mudd for us.
items.188: When one of you sneezes, let him say: “Praise be to Allah.” Let his brother or companion say to him: “May Allah have mercy on you.” When he has said that to him, let him reply: “May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.”
items.189: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.
items.190: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you and bring you together in goodness.
items.191: When one of you marries a woman or buys a servant, let him say: “O Allah, I ask You for her good and the good of the disposition You have given her, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of the disposition You have given her.” If he buys a camel, let him take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
items.192: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You have granted us.
items.193: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed.
items.194: Praise be to Allah who spared me what He tested you with and who favoured me greatly over many of those He created.
items.195: Ibn ʿUmar (may Allah be pleased with him) said: it used to be counted that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said a hundred times in a single gathering, before getting up: “My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Forgiving.”
items.196: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. I bear witness that there is no god worthy of worship but You; I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance.
items.198: May Allah reward you with good.
items.199: Whoever memorises the first ten verses of Surat Al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal. And one seeks refuge with Allah from his trial after the final tashahhud of every prayer.
items.200: May the One for whose sake you have loved me love you.
items.201: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.
items.202: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. The reward for a loan is praise and repayment.
items.203: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and I ask Your forgiveness for what I do not know.
items.204: And may Allah bless you too.
items.205: O Allah, there is no omen except Your omen, no good except Your good, and no god but You.
items.206: In the name of Allah, and praise be to Allah. “Glory be to Him who has placed this at our service, though we could not have mastered it ourselves, and to our Lord we shall return.” Praise be to Allah (three times), Allah is the greatest (three times). Glory be to You, O Allah, I have wronged myself: forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
items.207: Allah is the greatest (three times). “Glory be to Him who has placed this at our service, though we could not have mastered it ourselves, and to our Lord we shall return.” O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness, piety and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a sorrowful sight and from an evil return concerning wealth and family. On returning, say it again and add: “We return, repentant, worshipping, praising our Lord.”
items.208: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter, I ask You for the good of this village, the good of its people and the good of what is in it; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people and the evil of what is in it.
items.209: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
items.211: I entrust you to Allah, whose trusts are never lost.
items.212: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trustworthiness and the end of your deeds.
items.213: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sin and make good easy for you wherever you may be.
items.214: Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him) said: when we went up we would say “Allah is the greatest”, and when we went down we would say “Glory be to Allah”.
items.215: May a listener bear witness to our praise of Allah and His good favours upon us. Our Lord, accompany us and bestow Your favour upon us, as I seek refuge with Allah from the Fire.
items.216: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
items.217: He would say “Allah is the greatest” three times on every height, then: “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. We return, repentant, worshipping, praising our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, supported His servant and defeated the confederates alone.”
items.218: When something pleasing came to him, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) would say: “Praise be to Allah, by whose grace good deeds are completed.” When something he disliked came to him, he would say: “Praise be to Allah in every circumstance.”
items.219: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Whoever sends one prayer upon me, Allah sends ten prayers upon him.”
items.220: He also said: “Do not make my grave a place of festivity, but send prayers upon me: your prayers reach me wherever you are.”
items.221: He also said: “The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned and who does not send prayers upon me.”
items.222: He also said: “Allah has angels who roam the earth and convey to me the greeting of peace from my community.”
items.223: He also said: “No one greets me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greeting.”
items.224: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you of something that, if you do it, will make you love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among you.”
items.225: Three things: whoever combines them has combined faith: being fair to yourself, offering the greeting of peace to everyone and spending even when in need.
items.226: ʿAbdullah ibn ʿAmr (may Allah be pleased with them) reported that a man asked the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him): “What is best in Islam?” He replied: “That you feed people and greet those you know and those you do not know.”
items.227: When the People of the Book greet you, say: “And upon you.”
items.228: If you hear the crowing of roosters, ask Allah for His bounty, for they have seen an angel; and if you hear the braying of a donkey, seek refuge with Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.
items.229: If you hear dogs barking and donkeys braying at night, seek refuge with Allah from them, for they see what you do not see.
items.230: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “O Allah, for any believer I have insulted, make that a means of drawing near to You on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.231: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “If one of you must praise his companion, let him say: ‘I consider so-and-so to be such, and Allah is his reckoner; I do not declare anyone pure before Allah; I consider him — if he knows that of himself — to be such and such.’”
items.232: O Allah, do not hold me accountable for what they say, forgive me what they do not know, [and make me better than what they think].
items.233: Here I am, O Allah, here I am! Here I am, You have no partner, here I am! Praise, favour and sovereignty belong to You; You have no partner.
items.234: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) circled the House on a camel: each time he reached the corner of the Black Stone he pointed to it with something he held and said “Allah is the greatest”.
items.235: Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone, recite verse 201 of Surat Al-Baqara (Quran 2:201).
items.236: When the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) drew near to Safa, he recited: “Safa and Marwa are among the rites of Allah” (Quran 2:158), then said: “I begin with what Allah began with.” He began with Safa and climbed it until he saw the House, faced the qibla, affirmed Allah’s oneness and glorified Him, and said: “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no god worthy of worship but Allah alone: He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant and defeated the confederates alone.” Then he made supplication in between. He said this three times. At Marwa he did as he had done at Safa.
items.237: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The best supplication is the supplication of the day of ʿArafah, and the best thing that I and the prophets before me have said is: ‘There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.’”
items.238: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) rode his camel Al-Qaswa until he reached al-Mashʿar al-Haram; he faced the qibla, called upon Allah, glorified Him, said “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah” and affirmed His oneness. He stayed standing until the light was clearly visible, then set off before sunrise.
items.239: He said “Allah is the greatest” with each pebble he threw at the three pillars, then moved forward, stood facing the qibla and made supplication with raised hands after the first and the second pillar. At the pillar of al-ʿAqaba he threw his pebbles saying “Allah is the greatest” with each one, then left without stopping there.
items.242: When something pleasing came to him, or something he was pleased by, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) would prostrate in thanks to Allah, the Blessed, the Most High.
items.243: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say “In the name of Allah” (three times), then say seven times: “I seek refuge with Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.”
items.244: If one of you sees in his brother, in himself or in his property something that impresses him, [let him ask for blessing upon it], for the evil eye is real.
items.245: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah!
items.246: In the name of Allah, Allah is the greatest. [O Allah, this is from You and for You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
items.247: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can transgress, from the evil of what He created, formed and scattered, from the evil of what descends from the sky and what ascends into it, from the evil of what He spread on the earth and what comes out of it, from the evil of the trials of night and day, and from the evil of every night visitor, except one who comes with good, O Most Merciful.
items.248: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “By Allah, I ask Allah’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.”
items.249: He also said: “O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him a hundred times a day.”
items.250: He also said: “Whoever says: ‘I ask forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I turn to Him in repentance’, Allah forgives him, even if he fled from the battlefield.”
items.251: He also said: “The Lord is nearest to His servant in the last part of the night: if you can be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then do so.”
items.252: He also said: “A servant is nearest to his Lord when he is prostrating, so make many supplications.”
items.253: He also said: “My heart is at times veiled, and I ask Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.”
items.254: He said: “Whoever says ‘Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him’ a hundred times in a day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.”
items.255: He also said: “Whoever says ten times ‘There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things’ is like one who has freed four people from the descendants of Ismaʿil.”
items.256: He also said: “Two words, light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful: ‘Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him’, ‘Glory be to Allah, the Mighty’.”
items.257: He also said: “To say ‘Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the greatest’ is dearer to me than everything the sun rises upon.”
items.258: He also said: “Is any of you unable to earn a thousand good deeds each day?” One of those sitting with him asked: “How can one of us earn a thousand good deeds?” He replied: “He says ‘Glory be to Allah’ a hundred times: a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand sins are wiped away.”
items.259: Whoever says “Glory be to Allah, the Mighty, and praise be to Him” has a palm tree planted for him in Paradise.
items.260: He also said: “O ʿAbdullah ibn Qays, shall I not show you a treasure among the treasures of Paradise?” I said: “Yes, O Messenger of Allah.” He said: “Say: ‘There is no power and no might except with Allah.’”
items.261: He also said: “The words most beloved to Allah are four: ‘Glory be to Allah’, ‘Praise be to Allah’, ‘There is no god worthy of worship but Allah’ and ‘Allah is the greatest’. It does not matter which of them you begin with.”
items.262: A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) and said: “Teach me some words that I may say.” He replied: “Say: ‘There is no god worthy of worship but Allah, alone, without partner; Allah is the greatest, greatly so; praise be to Allah, abundant praise; glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; there is no power and no might except with Allah, the Almighty, the Wise.’” The man said: “These are for my Lord; what is for me?” He said: “Say: ‘O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me and provide for me.’”
items.263: When a man embraced Islam, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) would teach him the prayer, then instruct him to supplicate with these words: “O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being and provide for me.”
items.264: The best supplication is “Praise be to Allah”, and the best remembrance is “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah”.
items.265: The lasting good deeds: “Glory be to Allah”, “Praise be to Allah”, “There is no god worthy of worship but Allah”, “Allah is the greatest” and “There is no power and no might except with Allah”.
items.266: ʿAbdullah ibn ʿAmr (may Allah be pleased with him) said: I saw the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) count the tasbih on his right hand.
items.267: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “At dusk — or when you reach the evening — keep your children close, for the devils spread out then. Once some of the night has passed, let them go. Close the doors, mentioning the name of Allah, for Satan does not open a closed door; tie up your waterskins, mentioning the name of Allah; cover your vessels, mentioning the name of Allah, even if only by laying something across them; and put out your lamps.”
